skill.name: amazon-listing-competitor-analysis-skill
skill.description: Analyze a competitor Amazon ASIN with BrowserAct extraction, then turn listing content, reviews, and media signals into opportunity points.
skill.summary: Analyze Amazon competitor listings and identify market opportunities.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from Markdown formatting, inline examples, and expected BrowserAct setup text. Confirmed issues are the documented outbound BrowserAct API workflow, one intentional Python script invocation, and unsafe guidance that can cause users to paste API keys into chat. No prompt injection attempt was found in the audited files.

remediation.issue: API key guidance can lead users to disclose credentials in chat.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set in the environment or a secret manager. Remove instructions that ask users to provide the key to the agent.

remediation.issue: The skill sends listing inputs and task data to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: Clearly disclose the third-party data transfer before execution and ask for user confirmation when handling sensitive product research.

remediation.issue: The marketplace URL is user supplied and forwarded to the BrowserAct workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the marketplace URL against supported Amazon marketplace hosts before submitting a task.

remediation.issue: The workflow requires running a local Python command.
remediation.suggestion: Keep arguments safely quoted and prefer direct process invocation over shell interpolation in agents that support it.

content.value_statement: Amazon listing research is slow when teams must inspect titles, bullets, media, and reviews manually. This skill extracts one ASIN and turns the evidence into competitor insights and opportunity points.
actual_capabilities: Runs a BrowserAct workflow for one Amazon ASIN and marketplace URL.
Extracts visible listing fields such as title, price, rating, bullets, media URLs, seller, and review data.
Maps keyword placement across title, bullets, description, and A plus content when available.
Summarizes visual strategy from extracted image and video information.
Uses review themes to identify buyer-valued points and unmet needs.
Produces strategic opportunity points for the user's brand or product roadmap.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and network access to BrowserAct services.
Analyzes one competitor ASIN per run, not a full category dataset.
Depends on data returned by the BrowserAct workflow and Amazon page availability.
Does not estimate private sales, advertising spend, or unavailable conversion metrics.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Launch Gap Review
use_cases.description: Analyze a leading ASIN before launch and identify positioning, proof, and offer gaps your product can address.

use_cases.title: Audit Search Messaging
use_cases.description: Review title, bullet, description, and A plus keyword placement to understand how a competitor captures buyer intent.

use_cases.title: Mine Review-Led Opportunities
use_cases.description: Use reviews and mixed feedback to find unmet needs that can inform roadmap, bundles, claims, or support content.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One ASIN
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze ASIN B0CS62LY6P on Amazon US. Focus on what the competitor does well and where my brand can find opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Listing Messaging
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this competitor ASIN using the default marketplace. Emphasize title structure, bullet priority, differentiation language, and A plus content themes.

prompt_templates.title: Find Review-Based Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the competitor analysis for this ASIN and prioritize unmet buyer needs from mixed and critical reviews. Separate product gaps from messaging gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Strategic Opportunity Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this ASIN on the correct regional Amazon marketplace. Produce positioning whitespace, search intent opportunities, creative proof gaps, and offer ideas for my roadmap.

output_examples.input: Analyze a kitchen storage ASIN for launch planning.
output: The competitor leads with capacity and space-saving claims in the title and first bullets.
Reviews praise durability but repeatedly mention unclear sizing before purchase.
Opportunity points include clearer scale visuals, compatibility language, and a bundle option for small kitchens.

output_examples.input: Review a beauty product ASIN for keyword placement.
output: Primary terms appear early in the title, while use-case phrases are concentrated in later bullets.
The listing underuses buyer language around sensitive skin and travel use.
A competing brand could own those intents with evidence-backed claims and dedicated image panels.

output_examples.input: Find product roadmap ideas from competitor reviews.
output: Positive reviews validate ease of setup and perceived value.
Mixed reviews show recurring requests for stronger instructions and a more durable accessory.
Roadmap opportunities include an improved accessory, onboarding content, and warranty messaging.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an environment variable before running the skill.
Use the marketplace URL that matches the ASIN region for cleaner extraction results.
Treat extracted fields as evidence and avoid claims not supported by the returned data.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or store them in prompts.
Do not turn the output into edits for the competitor listing under review.
Do not infer sales, ad spend, or conversion rates from visible listing fields alone.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes one Amazon competitor listing by ASIN and returns evidence-based content, keyword, visual, review, and opportunity insights.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY for the BrowserAct workflow that extracts Amazon listing data.

faq.question: Can it compare many ASINs at once?
faq.answer: No. The included workflow is designed for one ASIN per run.

faq.question: Can it analyze non-US marketplaces?
faq.answer: Yes, when the user provides the correct Amazon marketplace URL and the BrowserAct workflow can access that listing.

faq.question: Does it write new Amazon copy?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on competitor diagnosis and opportunity synthesis, not rewriting the competitor listing.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
